title: South Ostrobothnia: €314,200 a year, about 1.0 lung cancer deaths avoided a year (modelled)
markdown:
# South Ostrobothnia: €314,200 a year, about 1.0 lung cancer deaths avoided a year (modelled)

> About 1.0 deaths avoided a year (modelled) · €314,200 of €1.00M · €685,800 left: nothing else pays off at these assumptions

## The gap

Of 100 lung cancer patients in South Ostrobothnia, 31 get treatment that aims to cure. In Finland it is 27. The difference is within what chance alone gives a county of this size. [^care_curative] There is no shortfall to close: the share treated to cure is at or above that of the best quarter of counties. [^model] South Ostrobothnia operates on more of its patients than Finland as a whole: 21.6% against 14.9%. [^care_surgery] This plan therefore ranks measures by lung cancer deaths avoided instead. [^model]

## The target

This plan is ranked by deaths avoided: about 1.0 a year (range −0.1 to 2.9), for €314,200 a year. [^model] Deaths avoided are modelled from stated assumptions, not observed. [^model] The low end is below zero: how much delay adds to lung cancer deaths is not statistically certain, so no benefit cannot be ruled out. [^model]

## Funded actions

| # | Action and owner | Cost a year | Deaths avoided a year (range) | First step this week | Measure: today → target |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| | **The county can start on Monday** | | | | |
| 1 | **Smoking cessation started at the first specialist visit**[^ev_smoking_cessation_at_diagnosis_1]. Chief physician and head nurse of pulmonology | €44,200 | 0.3 (0.1–0.8) | Write the standing order: every smoker with suspected lung cancer leaves the first visit with cessation medicine and a nurse call booked. | Share of smoking patients given cessation medicine at the first visit: not published today → 90% by 2027 |
| 2 | **Same-day chest X-ray report with immediate CT**[^ev_same_day_cxr_ct_1]. Chief radiologist together with the chief physician of primary care | €109,000 | 0.4 (−0.0 to 1.3) | Agree with radiology that a suspicious chest X-ray is followed by CT the same day, without a new referral. | Days from suspicious chest X-ray to CT: not published today → 3 days by 2027 |
| 3 | **Standardised lung cancer pathway with booked slots**[^ev_cpp_pathway_1]. Chief physician of pulmonology (county pathway); FICAN and the national lung cancer group (national pathway description) | €100,000 | 0.2 (−0.1 to 0.9) | Name one pathway owner and book fixed weekly CT, PET-CT, bronchoscopy and MDT slots for suspected lung cancer. | Days from diagnosis to start of treatment (median): 38.7 days → 36.9 days by 2028 |
| 4 | **Nurse navigator for every suspected lung cancer**[^ev_nurse_navigator_1]. Head nurses of pulmonology and oncology; director of nursing | €61,000 | 0.1 (0.0–0.1) | Name one nurse who books every test for each new suspected lung cancer patient and calls the patient with the dates. | Days from diagnosis to start of treatment (median): 38.7 days → 36.9 days by 2028 |
| | **Total** | **€314,200** | **1.0 (−0.1 to 2.9)** | | |

Effects are modelled from published studies and stated assumptions, not observed here. Costs are assumptions. [^model]

## Needs a national decision (outside this budget)

- **Low-dose CT screening for long-term heavy smokers**[^ev_ldct_screening_1]: Ministry of Social Affairs and Health and Palko (decision), Finnish Cancer Registry (steering), county (delivery). €588,422 a year; modelled to avoid 1.0 deaths a year (0.2–2.6). Not counted in this budget. Not a county decision. Ask the Ministry and Palko for the timetable after the 2026-2028 pilot and offer the county as a pilot site. [^model]

## What to measure from Monday

- Share of smoking patients given cessation medicine at the first visit: not published today → 90% by 2027. [^model]
- Days from suspicious chest X-ray to CT: not published today → 3 days by 2027. [^model]
- Days from diagnosis to start of treatment (median): 38.7 days → 36.9 days by 2028. [^care_time_to_treatment][^model]
- The registry's public figures cover 2019–2023; count these each month from the county's own records. [^care_curative]

## What more money buys, and what it cannot

The remaining EUR 685,800 buys nothing more, because no remaining measure adds deaths avoided within the plan's limit of EUR 1,000,000 per death avoided. [^model] Low-dose CT screening for long-term heavy smokers needs a national decision and cannot be bought from a county budget. [^model] Lung cancer causes about 82 deaths a year in South Ostrobothnia, and this plan is modelled to avoid 1.0 of them a year (range -0.08 to 2.9). [^deaths] [^model]

## Limits

- Every effect is an assumption, not a trial result. The range runs from all assumptions at their lowest to all at their highest, and it is not a probability. [^model]
- County shares are adjusted only for residents' age, not stage at diagnosis, other illness, histology, how cancer was found or smoking. County figures cannot show cause. [^model]
- The symptom-to-treatment clock is estimated, not measured. In a check against measured outcomes, 0 of 3 matched it beyond chance. [^model]
